title: Seacrest Beach Lagoon Pool, Courtyard & Balconies
meta_description: Laid Back: 4BR/3BA vacation home in Seacrest Beach with lagoon pool, private balconies, courtyard, bunk rooms, and beach access near dining & shopping. Sleeps 12.
description_expanded: AboutHome Highlights: ● Newly Remodeled! ● New furniture! ● Steps to community pool ● Close to private beach access ● Very Close! Walk to Starbucks, dining, and shopping at the Villages of South Walton ● Enjoy the community amphitheater ● Across the street from tram stop ● Close to Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, The HUB, and 30Avenue ● Enjoy private balconies and a private courtyard ● Fully stocked kitchen ● Free wifi ● Four backpack beach chairs and a beach umbrella ● Home is stocked with Starbucks coffee pack, creamer, sugar, bottles of water, and a starter amenity package with a roll of paper towels, dish soap, sponge, kitchen wipes, dishwasher soap, laundry detergent pods, pillow spray, shampoo, conditioner, aloe, lotion, bathroom soaps, and a roll of toilet paper in each bathroom. Welcome to your dream 30A vacation retreat in the heart of Seacrest Beach, where Laid Back invites you to experience coastal luxury. Perfectly positioned along 30A in Seacrest Beach, this 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom vacation home is just steps from a private beach access and the community's iconic 12,000-square-foot lagoon pool, surrounded by lush palm trees and inviting lounge areas. Imagine starting your mornings with a peaceful stroll to the nearby Starbucks for a latte, then grab breakfast at the Seacrest Cafe, followed by a leisurely walk along the community's scenic trails, or spend a fun-filled day at the beach or pool. You can enjoy boutique shopping and dining at the charming Villages of South Walton or lounging by the breathtaking lagoon pool - all just a stroll away. Every moment here is fun and easily accessed from Laid Back, with a community tram stop conveniently across the street. This home offers everything you need for the ultimate 30A vacation experience. As you enter the home, you are greeted by a light-filled, open-concept living space that blends coastal elegance with warm hospitality. The inviting living room flows seamlessly into a gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and an oversized island perfect for gathering with family and friends. Enjoy meals together indoors, or take your morning coffee to the private courtyard, a serene oasis for relaxation. Upstairs, the expansive balcony offers stunning views of the sparkling Gulf waters, providing the perfect setting to soak in the charm and luxury of your 30A vacation rental. Every detail has been thoughtfully designed to make your stay luxurious and comfortable. This beautiful home comfortably sleeps up to 12 guests, ideal for multi-generational families or large friend groups. On the first floor is a king bedroom with an adjacent full bath. Upstairs, the primary suite is a true retreat, featuring a king bed, spa-like ensuite bathroom, and a private balcony overlooking the palm-lined streets of 30A. Two additional bunk rooms, each equipped with two sets of queen-over-queen bunks, provide ample additional space, making this home as functional as it is luxurious. With high-quality linens, serene décor, and thoughtful touches, every guest feels at home. When staying at Laid Back, be amazed by Seacrest Beach's one-of-a-kind amenities, including its show-stopping lagoon pool. Whether you're lounging poolside, taking in the breathtaking views of South Walton's tallest coastal sand dunes, or enjoying the sugar-white sands and emerald waters. Being steps from the beach, Laid Back puts you in the center of the best 30A has to offer, including walking trails, the community Amphitheater that hosts events, and the charm of The Villages of South Walton, filled with unique shopping and dining experiences. From sunrises to sunset strolls, Laid Back offers a luxurious and hospitable experience in one of the most sought-after locations along 30A.
